title: Market Data Provider Expansion
purpose: Admit governed market-data providers as source-candidate producers for evidence gaps without allowing provider payloads to bypass claim extraction or Current Web Authority.
rules: Provider payload is never Current Evidence IR by itself.
Every provider record must retain providerId, capability, request parameters, retrievedAt and response digest.
Secrets, access tokens, refresh tokens, API keys and account credentials must never be persisted in provider snapshot files.
Moomoo market data is classified as MARKET_DATA_PROVIDER and is not promoted to OFFICIAL_PRIMARY.
Price, volume, order-book, flow, valuation and market-series claims belong to FINANCIAL_MARKETS CWA review.
Official filings, regulators, exchanges and official company disclosures retain higher authority for formal corporate or regulatory facts.
Provider-derived claims still pass W8B locator/lineage validation and W8C authority/freshness admission.
No provider call may directly change W8E grammar/domain support state.
